title: Yogurt-Topped Argentinian Mascarpone Empanadas
description: Savory empanadas filled with a creamy mascarpone and ferment-jang mixture, topped with a dollop of yogurt and a sprinkle of parsley, inspired by classic Argentinian cuisine.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, Parmesan cheese, and salt; whisk to combine.
Add cold butter to flour mixture and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add water to flour mixture and stir with a fork until dough comes together in a ball.
Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead a few times until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide dough into 8-10 equal pieces and roll each piece into a thin circle.
In a small bowl, mix together mascarpone cheese, ferment-jang, and black pepper.
Place a tablespoon of the mascarpone mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold dough over filling to form a half-moon shape and press edges together to seal.
Place empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush tops with a little water.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm topped with a dollop of yogurt and a sprinkle of parsley.
